bagPolicy.summary: For safety and security, only small clutches, belt bags, fanny-packs, or clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” are allowed. Backpacks are not permitted.
allowed: clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12”
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking can be added to your ticket purchase for a guaranteed space at 1141 Eastern Avenue, located behind the venue. It's recommended to purchase parking in advance to ensure availability.

rideshare.note: For pickups and drop-offs, the designated Lyft zone is located at Kishigo Lane Rideshare, PUDO: 43.666392, -79.314892.

concessions.note: History offers custom menus, premium beers, and handcrafted cocktails to cater to various appetites and event needs. The venue collaborates with culinary partners to provide personalized food and beverage services.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The Accessible Seating Area is located on the Mezzanine level. Both levels have accessible bathrooms, and a designated area for those with accessibility issues.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in History's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Lost and forgotten items can be picked up on show days at our Box Office, which opens 1 hour before the scheduled Doors time. The box office operates only on show days and opens one hour prior to the advertised door time, until 10pm.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at History. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
